action: General advice: state and local government IT teams can use the sector breakdown to prioritise intrusion prevention and patching of internet-facing systems; read SonicWall's own report for its recommendations.
date_note: The page gives only its publication day; the SonicWall report's own release date was not read.

evidence.quote: avançou 242% no primeiro semestre em relação ao ano anterior

exec: A security vendor reports a 242% rise in attacks on state and local governments in the first half of 2026, as relayed by a Brazilian outlet.
plain: Security company SonicWall says attacks on state and local governments grew 242% in the first half of 2026 compared with the year before, according to a Brazilian news report.
summary: Security Leaders reports that SonicWall's 2026 State and Local Government Protection Report found attacks on state and local governments grew 242% in the first half of 2026 compared with the year before. The report draws on a global study from SonicWall sensors. CyberView read only this relayed account, not SonicWall's report.
title: SonicWall report: attacks on state and local governments up 242% in H1 2026

validation.note: Single source: Security Leaders (Brazil) relaying SonicWall's report; the SonicWall original was not read.
